subject: APAC: regional cache eviction  customer advisory (Sunvale Retail)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 06:15:00 +0000
Subject: [ALERT] APAC kV-cache thrash detected — p95 elevation

Team —

Observability note: starting ~2026-05-10 05:58 UTC we saw unusual kV-cache evictions on a subset of APAC inference nodes that correlate with elevated p95 for hosted text-generation in the apac-1 region. Key points: 
- Scope: ~12% of APAC request traffic routed to pool-apac-1b (fallback routing still enabled)
- Symptom: increased p95 (requests with streaming) and intermittent truncated chunks
- Immediate mitigation: we throttled prefix-prefetch and applied a temporary cache retention bump to affected pool; telemetry shows partial improvement but p95 still ~2.6x baseline

I captured a dump and logs (attached short archive) and flagged for customer communication. Recommending a short advisory to impacted customers with clear mitigation and an ETA for next update.

Hannah
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: apac-kvcache-dump-20260510.tar.gz (log archive, ~12MB - truncated stub)

From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 07:02:00 +0000
Subject: DRAFT: customer advisory for Sunvale - APAC degradation

Marissa / Priyom —

Drafting a short external note for Sunvale (impacting apac-1 region). Please review for tone & content before I send. Aim: simple explanation, current mitigation, and when we expect next update. Proposed body below.

--- DRAFT OUTBOUND ---
Subject: Brief advisory: temporary APAC inference degradation (May 10)

Hi Olivia / team,

We wanted to let you know we are currently observing degraded inference latency for a subset of requests originating in the APAC region (apac-1). Our engineering and SRE teams have identified the root cause as an unexpected kV-cache eviction pattern on a small number of inference hosts that can increase P95 and, in some cases, result in truncated streaming output.

What we’re doing: we’ve applied a temporary cache retention adjustment and rate-limited prefetch on the affected pool, and we’re routing new requests away from the most impacted hosts. We have a full run of diagnostics in progress and will post an incident update to our status page within 60 minutes.

Customer impact: you may see occasional higher-latency requests and rare truncated streaming responses for sessions routed through APAC. Requests routed via other regions are unaffected.

Next update: by 08:00 UTC with ETA for a permanent remediation and a follow-up postmortem within 3 business days.

We’re sorry for the disruption — please reply here if you’d like immediate help routing traffic to an alternate region or to enable temporary request-level fallback settings.

Thanks,
Diego
Customer Reliability
---
